name: How do I maintain my newly painted interior walls?

mainEntity.name: How do I maintain my newly painted interior walls?

acceptedAnswer.text: To maintain your newly painted interior walls, avoid harsh chemical cleaners. For most spills or marks, a soft cloth with mild soap and water is usually sufficient. Address stains promptly to prevent them from setting. Keep an extra can of your chosen paint for touch-ups. With proper care, your new paint job will look fresh for years.
acceptedAnswer.description: Maintain new paint with mild soap and water; avoid harsh cleaners and keep extra paint for touch-ups.
